mechanism: Furosemide increases uric acid reabsorption in the proximal tubule, while pyrazinamide increases serum uric acid levels, creating a combined hyperuricemic effect that increases risk of gout and may precipitate acute gouty arthritis.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and signs of gout; consider alternative antituberculous agent or prophylactic urate-lowering therapy (allopurinol) if combination cannot be avoided.
